fields.name: image
fields.label: Background image
fields.description: Fills the hero behind the heading (cropped to fit; the design's cool tone is added over it).

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Background image alt text
fields.description: Describe the photo for screen readers, e.g. People in silhouette before a city skyline. Leave empty if it is only decorative.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The page's main heading, e.g. THE WORLD NEEDS PIONEERS (it wraps onto two lines).

fields.name: description
fields.label: Subheading / description
fields.description: Optional: a short paragraph under the heading.

fields.name: ctaLabel
fields.label: Button label
fields.description: E.g. SCROLL or VIEW OPENINGS. Leave empty for no button.

fields.name: ctaLink
fields.label: Button link
fields.description: #open-roles scrolls smoothly down to the Job Board on this page (any #anchor: to the element with that id, else to the job board); a page path or URL opens that page.
